page.overview:
Who is Sterling?

Not much is known about Sterling before the events of Cars 3 other than him being a possible acquaintance of Miles Axlerod.

At some point after Lightning McQueen's crash, Sterling buys out Rust-eze Medicated Bumper Ointment. Using his wealth, Sterling creates a racing center for next-gen racers. He introduces Lightning to the center's trainer, Cruz Ramirez, and assigns her to train Lightning. However, Lightning's overconfidence damages the simulator, causing a temporary blackout in the entire building. Sterling then suggests Lightning to quit racing and profit off his merchandise, knowing he cannot outcompete the next-gen racers. Lightning refuses and bugs Sterling into letting him have his way, promising to forfeit the rights to his brand if he does not win the Florida 500. Not wanting to take any chances, Sterling agrees on the condition Lightning brings Ramirez to train. When Lightning ends up revealing his identity at Thunder Hollow, Sterling covers it by claiming Lightning is taking an "unconventional" approach.

Lightning eventually returns to Florida 500, where Sterling decides to send Cruz back to the training center for the other racers. Against Sterling's decision, Lightning calls Cruz back and had her outfitted for the race while Mater blocks Sterling from intervening. He changes his mind after Cruz wins, but Cruz refuses to race for him in favor of Tex Dinoco, so he decides to get Lightning to attend a photo shoot. However, many others point out Lightning gets to decide, as he and Cruz raced under the same number. Sterling's objections are interrupted by Tex, who offers to discuss their terms in private. Tex later reveals Sterling agreed to Rust-eze to him.

In Disney Crossy Road, Sterling appears as a unlockable and playable character in the Cars pack of the game.
